example.py: zhè chuàn pútáo yòu tián yòu dà。
example.en: This bunch of grapes is sweet and big.
example.ru: Эта гроздь винограда сладкая и крупная.

example.py: qǐng nǐ lái wǒ jiā。
example.en: Please come to my home.

example.zh: 这盆花被晒得半死不活。
example.py: zhè pén huā bèi shài de bànsǐbùhuó。
example.en: This potted flower was scorched half to death.
example.ru: Этот цветок на солнце совсем зачах.

example.zh: 我刚出门，不料下起大雨。
example.py: wǒ gāng chūmén, bùliào xià qǐ dàyǔ。
example.en: I had just gone out when, unexpectedly, heavy rain started.
example.ru: Я только вышел, как неожиданно начался сильный дождь.

example.py: tā jìngrán wàng le wǒ de míngzi。
example.en: He actually forgot my name.
example.ru: Он, представьте себе, забыл моё имя.

example.py: gōngyuán lǐ yǒu xǔduō rén。
example.en: There are many people in the park.

example.py: qiūtiān yèzi biàn huáng le。
example.en: In autumn the leaves turn yellow.

example.py: tā xiǎng dāng lǎoshī。
example.en: He wants to be a teacher.

example.py: Wǒ mǎi le yī chuàn pútao.
example.en: I bought a bunch of grapes.

example.zh: 她穿了一件紫色的裙子。
example.py: tā chuān le yí jiàn zǐsè de qúnzi。
example.en: She wore a purple skirt.

example.zh: 他从树上摘了一个苹果。
example.py: tā cóng shù shang zhāi le yí gè píngguǒ。
example.en: He picked an apple from the tree.

example.zh: 他和朋友分享了好消息。
example.py: tā hé péngyou fēnxiǎng le hǎo xiāoxi。
example.en: He shared the good news with his friends.
example.ru: Он поделился хорошей новостью с друзьями.

example.py: jīnnián de shōuhuò hěn dà。
example.en: This year's harvest is great.

example.py: Tā liǎn shàng chōngmǎn le xǐyuè.
example.en: Her face was full of joy.

example.py: tā jiā de shēngyi yuè zuò yuè dà。
example.en: His family's business keeps growing.
example.ru: Их семейный бизнес становится всё больше.

example.py: tā yòng shǒuzhǐ zhǐ zhe dìtú。
example.en: He is pointing at the map with his finger.

example.py: Māma niē le yíxià wǒ de liǎn.
example.en: Mom pinched my cheek.

example.py: Dìdi chī le yì kē táng.
example.en: My little brother ate a piece of candy.

example.py: yīshēng ràng wǒ zhāng kāi zuǐ。
example.en: The doctor asked me to open my mouth.

example.py: zhè zhī māo shì báisè de。
example.en: This cat is white.

example.py: tā zhùshì zhe yuǎnfāng de dàhǎi。
example.en: He gazed at the distant sea.
example.ru: Он пристально смотрел на далёкое море.

example.py: tā dīshēng shuō le yī jù xièxie。
example.en: He said thank you in a low voice.

example.py: zhè zhāng zhuōzi tài dī le。
example.en: This table is too low.

example.py: tā gāoshēng lǎngdú kèwén。
example.en: He read the text aloud.

example.py: tā de biǎoqíng hěn qíguài。
example.en: His facial expression is very strange.
example.ru: У него очень странное выражение лица.

example.py: tā bìng bù zhīdào zhè jiàn shì。
example.en: He actually doesn't know about this.
example.ru: Он вовсе не знает об этом.

example.py: wǒ de línjū shì lǎoshī。
example.en: My neighbor is a teacher.

example.py: zhège jiéguǒ ràng rén hěn yìwài。
example.en: This result was quite unexpected.

example.py: tā hé zhàngfu yīqǐ qù lǚyóu。
example.en: She went traveling together with her husband.
example.ru: Она поехала в путешествие вместе с мужем.

example.py: wǎnshang chūmén yào tígāo jǐngtì。
example.en: Stay alert when going out at night.

example.py: Dāngshí wǒ juéde hěn gāngà.
example.en: I felt very awkward at the time.
example.ru: Тогда я почувствовал себя очень неловко.

example.zh: 这种植物含有毒药成分。
example.py: zhè zhǒng zhíwù hányǒu dúyào chéngfèn。
example.en: This plant contains poisonous components.

example.py: zhège gùshi chuán le jǐ bǎi nián。
example.en: This story has been passed down for centuries.

example.py: tāmen yòu chǎojià le。
example.en: They quarreled again.

example.py: Wǒ zhù zài tā jiā gébì.
example.en: I live next door to him.
example.ru: Я живу по соседству с ним.

example.py: Zǎoshang cǎo shang yǒu lùshuǐ.
example.en: In the morning there is dew on the grass.

example.py: xiǎohái gāoxìng de bèng le qǐlai。
example.en: The child jumped up happily.

example.py: xiǎo tùzi tiào lái tiào qù。
example.en: The little rabbit hops around.

example.py: tā shì wǒ zhēnzhèng de péngyou。
example.en: He is my true friend.
